cards.description: Leadership trainings don't need to be dry and theoretical. hero.title: The Clarity Retreat
hero.subtitle: Four days to step out of the noise, reconnect with yourself, and return with a clear head and a plan that's truly yours.

intro.title: You don't need more hustle. You need space to think.
intro.paragraph: Between back-to-back meetings, other people's priorities, and the quiet pressure to always have it together, it's easy to lose touch with what you actually want. This retreat is a deliberate pause - four days away from your inbox, in a small group, to reflect, reset, and get honest with yourself about what's next.

for-who.title: This retreat is for you if...
items: You're successful on paper, but something still feels off
You're at a crossroads - in your career or your life - and want clarity before you decide
You crave real reflection time, not another productivity hack
You want to reconnect with your body, not just your to-do list
You're ready to be honest with yourself, in good company

cards.title: Guided Reflection Sessions
cards.description: Structured 1:1 and small-group sessions to help you get clear on what matters and what's next.
items: A concrete plan to take home

cards.title: Embodiment & Movement
cards.description: Gentle practices to help you reconnect with your body and access insights that thinking alone can't reach.

cards.title: Small-Group Coaching Circles
cards.description: Held, confidential spaces to be witnessed and to learn from others going through similar transitions.

cards.title: Rest, Food & Space
cards.description: Everything is taken care of, so all you need to bring is yourself.

days.title: Arrival & Grounding
days.description: Arrive, settle in, and shift gears. We open with a welcome circle and a first gentle movement session to leave the everyday behind.

days.title: Clarity
days.description: We dig into what's really going on - your values, your patterns, and where things feel stuck. Expect honest conversations and a few surprising insights.

days.title: Integration
days.description: A quieter day to let things settle, with space for nature, rest, and small-group coaching circles to test new ways of thinking out loud.

days.title: Departure With A Plan
days.description: We close by turning insight into a concrete, realistic plan - so the clarity doesn't stay behind when you leave.

host.title: Hosted by Sarah
paragraphs: I've spent over a decade helping people and teams get unstuck - as a product leader, and now as a trainer, coach, and consultant. I know first-hand how easy it is to keep performing while quietly losing touch with what you actually want.

I created this retreat because the best clarity rarely happens in a 45-minute call between meetings. It needs space, distance, and honest company - which is exactly what I want to give you these four days.

quote.prefix: I came in exhausted and unsure, and left with
quote.highlight: more clarity about my next career step than a year of thinking on my own had given me
quote.suffix: . Sarah creates a space where you can actually be honest with yourself - and the group made it feel safe to do that.
